text:
Jordan Park: quick check — anyone see ephemeral GPU slots in APAC tonight? need ~2h for a small h100 quant smoke, ideally 23:00-01:00 SGT
Samir Patel: how many cards do you need? we might have 2x h100 in the staging carve but tag/billing needs clearing
Jordan Park: 2x h100 is perfect, low batch size. can tolerate a short preemption but prefer stable 2h window
Lee Wong: @Samir can you try reserving from the standby allocator? otherwise fallback to a100s in asia-southeast1
Samir Patel: checking now. if allocator blocks i'll open a quick carve PR and ping finance for tag approval :hourglass_flowing_sand:
ops-bot: Heads-up: current region quotas — asia-southeast1: GPUs=48/64, h100=4/6, a100=10/12. Free h100 capacity: 2. Link: https://internal.ops/quotas (auto-update)
Raj Chen: if the h100 reservation fails, run with 4x a100 but set batch_size=1 and reduce beam to 1, should still surface quant regressions
Jordan Park: jotting command i'll run if we get reserve:
```
# quick smoke create (staging)
gcloud compute instances create h100-smoke --zone=asia-southeast1-a --accelerator type=nvidia-h100,count=2 --metadata env=staging,owner=jordan
```
Samir Patel: opened a carve PR (CR-7782) to attach demo:inference tag, pinged finance for quick approve
Lee Wong: FYI if quota check errors occur run:
`gcloud compute regions describe asia-southeast1 --format=json quotas`
Samir Patel: allocator responded: reserved request R-2026-443, expires in 2h starting 23:05 SGT. ops-bot also logged the reservation
Jordan Park: perfect — will start at 23:05 SGT and drop results here. if it preempts i'll failover to Raj's a100 plan. thanks all :rocket:
Lee Wong: :thumbsup: ping if you need help with teardown script
ops-bot: Reservation R-2026-443 — status: active, nodes: 2 h100, expires: 1773975600 (UNIX).
